h2: Leadership Brief: Guiding Stage Ministry Decisions

p: To help pastors and ministry leaders make informed, prayerful decisions about pageant scope, volunteer load, and creative direction.

li: Mission Alignment - Every performance must reinforce the church's vision and theology.
Stewardship - Consider budget, facility use, and volunteer capacity before committing to scope or schedule.
Safety & Sustainability - Favor smaller, consistent excellence over large, exhausting undertakings.
Accessibility - Aim for clarity of message; avoid complexity that distracts from the Gospel.
[ ] Script/theme approved by pastoral team
[ ] Budget & resources confirmed
[ ] Volunteer coordinator assigned
[ ] Safety plan reviewed
[ ] Post-event evaluation scheduled

blockquote: Creativity is not decoration — it is declaration.

p: Art exists because God is creative. From Genesis 1 onward, creation reveals design, order, and beauty that reflect His nature.
When we paint, act, sing, or build sets, we echo the Creator. Our goal is not self-expression but God-expression — revealing His truth through beauty.

li: Exodus 31:1-5 - Bezalel filled with the Spirit to craft the tabernacle.
Psalm 33:3 - “Sing to Him a new song.”
Colossians 3:23 - “Whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord.”

p: Every creative act in ministry should:

li: Glorify God
Edify the Church
Invite others into worship
